remarks: Tucked away off the main driveway with parking just steps from the unit door together with a quiet rear courtyard setting makes this spot one of the best at Sylvan Knoll! Three levels of townhouse style living with hardwood floors on the main and upper levels that will easily shine again. The lower level is a large comfortable space perfect for many different uses with a separate laundry room/mechanical room/storage room. The pull down attic is floored for additional storage. Newer HVAC equipment. Taxes are included in the monthly common charges. Here's an opportunity to renovate to your exact specifications!
